decision: Confirm that frozen snapshots preserve the full native JSONL plus the normal older-history LambdaDB partition, without uploading retained recent messages during save or either resume.

timing: Record client-observed LambdaClient.createBranch calls separately from parent commit waits, reconciliation and verification. Full operation timers retain exact committed document-set checks. Exclude return navigation, isolation-edit verification and cleanup. One observation per size and operation, not a latency distribution.
fairness: Reuse unchanged historical built-in Vector Storage results as separately dated observations. Do not compare one branch-create API call with full native indexing time as equivalent latency boundaries.
completion: Complete ten timed operations; save and both resumes submit zero documents; JSONL message rows are identical; an older edit on one resumed path leaves its sibling, frozen snapshot and original path unchanged; verify owned cleanup.
